domain_info.name: humanoid_track
domain_info.title: Humanoid motion tracking
domain_info.description: Agents write a whole-body controller for a Unitree G1 in MuJoCo that follows a reference motion (a motion capture clip fitted to the robot) and stays on its feet, and report a success rate from the one practice motion; we run it on motions it never saw, half of them demanding. The task and its tracking errors follow ExBody2.
